# Standpoint Modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StandpointModality`](gmeow-StandpointModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StandpointModality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The belief value a standpoint assigns a proposition — a closed value vocabulary spanning the Standpoint-Logic □/◊ and the [CRMinf](../../external/ontologies.md#target-crminf) belief value (true/false/probable/possible), plus the Frankfurt bullshit modality: [`gmeow:unequivocal`](../individuals/gmeow-unequivocal.md), [`gmeow:probable`](../individuals/gmeow-probable.md), [`gmeow:conceivable`](../individuals/gmeow-conceivable.md), [`gmeow:refuted`](../individuals/gmeow-refuted.md), [`gmeow:bullshit`](../individuals/gmeow-bullshit.md). Absence of a value is read as unequivocal.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:StandpointModality`](gmeow-StandpointModality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for HOW a standpoint holds a proposition — the closed set of belief values (unequivocal, probable, conceivable, refuted, bullshit) a claim declares through [`gmeow:standpointModality`](../properties/gmeow-standpointModality.md) or [`gmeow:claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:confidence`](../properties/gmeow-confidence.md) (our certainty about the stance) or with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) (whose frame); modality is how settled the standpoint itself holds the claim, an axis orthogonal to those. Never use a refuted value to mark a proposition globally false — refutation is one standpoint's denial, never a winner over the rest ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded modality individuals from a [`StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) via [`gmeow:claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) or from an annotated statement via [`gmeow:standpointModality`](../properties/gmeow-standpointModality.md); leave the value absent to mean unequivocal, and keep competing modalities on coexisting claims rather than resolving them.

### Examples

- ex:claim [`gmeow:standpointModality`](../properties/gmeow-standpointModality.md) [`gmeow:refuted`](../individuals/gmeow-refuted.md).
